svg.title: Adding boat and river velocities
svg.desc: The boat points north relative to the water. The current flows east. A head-to-tail vector triangle gives the boat’s northeast velocity relative to shore; θ is measured north of east. The boat icons point north while their positions drift northeast. An animated companion below illustrates the process; its complete static alternative is shown for reduced motion and print.

g.text: River current changes the boat’s ground track
Constant velocities: ground velocity = boat relative to water + water relative to bank.
Illustrative motion • slowed down • cycle restarts
